stratagems.name: Shoulder of the Mountain
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit from your army that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack (min 1).

stratagems.name: Rotate Ion Shields
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the invulnerable save of models in your unit by 1 (to a maximum of 3+).

stratagems.name: Knight's Oath
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics of that attack.

stratagems.name: Lay Low the Mighty
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack against a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
